name: Tyre pressure sensor relearn
description: Teaches the car the tyre pressure sensors after new sensors or swapping wheels. Many Mk7 Fiestas use a system that works from the ABS wheel speeds instead of sensors - that kind is reset from the dashboard menu, not here.
source: Waiting for the commands to be found on a real car
preconditions: Tyres set to the pressures on the door pillar sticker
